name: Trogdor: Reburninated
author: Mode8fx
description_short: Enhanced GameCube port of the classic Homestar Runner Flash game. Burninate the countryside as Trogdor the dragon.
description_long: Faithful recreation of the original Flash game Trogdor, expanded with new features: configurable gameplay settings, difficulty presets, level select and shuffle, save data with mid-game progress and high score, new cheats alongside the original Konami code, optional Stinkoman 20X6 soundtrack, screen scaling options, bug fixes from the original game, and big head mode.
